title: Rolls-Royce small modular reactor
summary: A 470 MWe pressurised-water SMR selected for UK deployment.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Rolls-Royce SMR is a factory-built pressurised-water reactor design of about 470 MWe, selected by Great British Nuclear in 2025 as the preferred technology for the UK programme. SMRs aim to cut construction risk through modular manufacturing, but the design still requires generic design assessment and site licensing. First power is a 2030s proposition.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Pilot
Estimated window 2030–2035
Confidence label Researching
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

SMR economics depend on repeating an identical unit many times; a single build proves nothing about cost.

What Would Change The View

  • Generic design assessment progress.
  • Final investment decision.
  • Supply-chain readiness for forgings.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
